neighbours.label: nouns that name a part of a larger whole ('portion', 'part', 'section', 'region', Spanish 'zona'), as against the same sentence naming the whole
fire: Snow is likely in the western portion of the state tonight.
For me the best part of the movie was the final chase scene.
The team played the road portion of its schedule in March.
El dolor se concentra en la zona lumbar de la espalda.
Roofers repaired the damaged section of the barn.
Fog covered the lower regions of the valley at dawn.
Only a small portion of the budget goes to research.
The front part of the car was crushed in the crash.
